rules: Each advance moves one or more fixed cells. Turns take effect on the next cell; never reverse.
Coral fruit grows the snake by one cell and earns 10 points.
Every five coral fruits increases speed and reveals a golden fruit worth 50 points for 52 cell steps.
Golden fruit does not grow the snake. Touching a wall or your own body ends the run.
There is no score quota: chase your personal best. Pausing and animation are outside the simulation.

rules: Launch from the shooter lane. Time the left and right flippers to keep the ball in play.
Each bumper scores 100 times the multiplier. Light all three to raise it, up to 5×, and collect a constellation bonus.
Slingshots score 25 times the multiplier. Scores and multiplier carry across three balls.
A ball passing below the table drains. Launch the next ball manually. The game ends after the third drain.
